from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        shared = operator.SharedMemory(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            num_rounds=2,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.TENTS_SHARED_WORKER_PROMPT] * 3,
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.TENTS_SHARED_AGG_PROMPT,
        )
        draft = await shared(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_rounds=2,
            prompts=[prompt_custom.TENTS_REVIEW_PROMPT, prompt_custom.TENTS_FINALIZE_PROMPT],
        )
        solution = await seq(problem + "\n\nCandidate answer:\n" + draft["response"])
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

Problem:
{problem}

Current shared document:
{document}

Your role:

- If you provide a board draft, keep trees unchanged and place tents only on empty cells.

Round: {round}
Agent: {agent_id}

Write a concise update to the shared document. If giving a candidate board, use:

Candidate:
<begin_board>
[board rows]
<end_board>"""

Construct the best final candidate from the document and ensure ALL constraints hold:
- tents only on former . cells
- each tree has exactly one orthogonally adjacent tent
- no two tents touch in 8 directions

Return only:
Solution: ...
<begin_board>
[final board rows]
<end_board>

{problem}

{document}"""
